cli.team_bridge.help.group: Agent messages (Team Bridge): the background receiver
cli.team_bridge.help.receiver: The background receiver that delivers agent messages to your chief of staff
cli.team_bridge.help.status: Show the receiver's service state, log and last check
cli.team_bridge.help.install: Install and start the receiver for this machine (needs agent messages turned on)
cli.team_bridge.help.remove: Stop and remove the receiver service (agent messages stay on)
cli.team_bridge.help.logs: Show the receiver's recent log lines
cli.team_bridge.status.state: Receiver: {state, select, loaded{running (the service manager holds it)} installed{installed, but not running} missing{not installed} no_supervisor{no service manager on this machine} no_user_manager{systemd has no user session for this login} isolated{not available for this configuration folder} other{unknown}}
cli.team_bridge.status.enrolment: Agent messages: {state, select, on{on for this machine} off{turned off on this machine} not_enrolled{not set up on this machine} other{could not be read}}
cli.team_bridge.status.journal: Output that escapes the log goes to the journal: {command}
cli.team_bridge.status.last_check_never: Last inbox check: none recorded yet
cli.team_bridge.status.linger: Runs after logout: {state, select, yes{yes (lingering is on)} other{no — to keep it running when you are logged out, run: {command}}}
cli.team_bridge.status.isolated_note: This configuration folder is not your default one, so the shared receiver service is never installed for it, and no session receives its agent messages on its own. To receive them for this folder, run the receiver yourself: {command}
cli.team_bridge.status.no_supervisor_not: Run the receiver in the foreground instead: {command}
cli.team_bridge.status.screening_healthy: Screening: nothing held or rejected in the last 24h · breaker closed
cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held: {count, plural, one {# held} other {# held}} ({codes}; oldest {age})
cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held_cl: {count, plural, one {# held} other {# held}} ({codes}; oldest {age}; mostly {failure_class})
cli.team_bridge.status.screening_breaker: breaker {state, select, open{open for {remaining} ({failures, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}})} failing{closed ({failures, plural, one {# recent failure} other {# recent failures}})} other{closed}}
cli.team_bridge.status.screening_rejecte: {count, plural, one {# rejected in 24h} other {# rejected in 24h}} ({categories})
cli.team_bridge.outcome.installed: The receiver is installed and running.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.current: The receiver is already installed and running; nothing changed.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.registered: The receiver was installed but not running; it has been started again.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.removed: The receiver service was stopped and removed.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.absent: There is no receiver service to remove.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.not_wanted: Agent messages are not set up or are turned off on this machine, so nothing was installed.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.not_wanted_hint: Agent messages are not set up, or are turned off, for this machine. Consent and the chief of staff are chosen in the Local Operator app: open it once, sign in as the account owner and enable Agent messages. Then run `lop team-bridge setup` here to check and place the receiver.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.remove_hint: Agent messages are still on, so the receiver will be installed again the next time Local Operator starts. To stop receiving messages, turn agent messages off: `lop config edit team_bridge.enabled false`.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.no_supervisor: This machine has no user service manager, so the receiver cannot be installed. {detail}
cli.team_bridge.outcome.no_user_manager: systemd has no user session for this login, so the receiver could not be installed. {detail}
cli.team_bridge.outcome.isolated: This configuration folder ({path}) is not your default one ({default}), so the shared receiver service was left alone. To receive agent messages for this folder, run the receiver yourself: {command}
cli.team_bridge.outcome.source_checkout: This copy of Local Operator runs from a source checkout, so it will not point your receiver service at it. Install Local Operator normally, then run this again.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.not_addressable: The receiver's service file was written, but this process cannot reach your real service manager (its home folder is redirected). It takes effect at your next login.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.unknown: Agent messages' settings could not be read, so the receiver was left as it is.
cli.team_bridge.outcome.failed: The receiver could not be changed: {detail}
cli.team_bridge.help.setup: Check that this machine is ready for agent messages, and place the receiver. Consent is granted in the Local Operator app
cli.team_bridge.setup.consent_ui_require: Team Bridge consent is granted in the Local Operator app, not from a terminal. Open the app once and enable Agent messages.
cli.team_bridge.setup.consent_ui_next: This machine is not enrolled, so there is nothing to install yet. After the app has enabled Agent messages for this configuration folder, run this command again.
cli.team_bridge.setup.enable_in_app_requ: Agent messages are set up for {account_id} but are not switched on for this machine. Open the Local Operator app once and enable Agent messages, then run this command again.
cli.team_bridge.setup.designation_missin: Agent messages are set up for {account_id}, but no chief-of-staff session is committed for it. Open the Local Operator app and choose the session that should answer your agents.
cli.team_bridge.setup.ready: Agent messages: ready. Account {account_id}, chief-of-staff session {session}, and the receiver is in place.
cli.team_bridge.setup.not_ready: Agent messages are set up, but the receiver was not placed ({service}). {detail}
cli.team_bridge.setup.failed: The readiness check could not run. Nothing was changed.
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_t: Agent messages: a sender looks like probing
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_b: Your agent's moderation refused several messages from the same sender in the last day. That pattern can mean someone is testing what your agent accepts. The sender is no longer told why their messages are refused.
